about: Read-only calls that use POST. Scenario scripts may use only Get-Mg* cmdlets and Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method GET, plus the entries below. Every use must carry the comment '# read-only, uses POST' on the same line. tests/test_scripts.py enforces this.
label: read-only, uses POST

Start-MgSecurityHuntingQuery.why: Runs an advanced hunting (KQL) query. It reads data and changes nothing.

Invoke-MgExtractDriveItemSensitivityLabe.why: Reads the labels in a file. Learn notes it can refresh the label metadata stored for the file; it doesn't change the file or its label.

Test-MgIdentityConditionalAccess.why: Conditional Access What If. It evaluates the policies for a user and app without changing them.

Invoke-MgQuerySearch.why: Microsoft Search query. It only reads results.

/security/auditLog/queries.why: Creates an audit log search, which Purview runs in the background. The results are read with GET. It changes no tenant data.
